feeds.title: Roller Girl Gang Blog
feeds.description: We want to inspire everyone to roller skate! Come and learn with us or invite us to your event. We also stock roller skates and accessories. Find out why we love life on eight wheels, learn how to care for your roller skates and how we decide on products for our shop.

feeds.title: Skate Moore Skate Center Blog
feeds.description: Skate Today, Skate Tomorrow, Skate Moore! Skate Moore Skate Center is a family owned and family friendly fun center located in Moore.

feeds.title: Dogdays Magazine
feeds.description: Dogdays Magazine is a print magazine for aggressive and creative roller skating, based in Germany.

feeds.title: Skatefresh Blog
feeds.description: London Inline Skating and Rollerblading Lessons. Skatefresh is an International Online Professional Teaching Academy, with a unique Teaching Strategy. We provide a 'Hub' for all skaters to gain Professional Tuition in the Art of Skating so you have an experience that is fun, progressive, safe and enjoyable, right from the start.

feeds.title: Lucky Skates Pty Ltd Blog
feeds.description: Lucky Skates is your roller skate and inline specialist in Perth, Western Australia, owned and run by two unicorn loving skaters - Minnie and PT. Whether you're learning to roller skate or blade for the first time, taking it up again after many years off skates or a seasoned pro - we want to help you achieve all your wildest skating dreams with the best gear and advice for you.

feeds.title: RollerSk8r
feeds.description: RollerSk8r blog is designed to provide skaters with a place to learn the proper way to skate while providing a community for conversations based on our love of the past time.

feeds.title: Southeastern Skate Supply Blog
feeds.description: Check our blog and see all of our skating supplies and equipment, in all types of sizes, styles and colors. Southeastern Skate Supply was established in 1954 as a distributor of skates and skating supplies for the roller skate market. Over the years we have continued to adapt along with the skate industry. We now carry quad and inline skates along with a complete line of novelties.

feeds.title: Eastern Skating Supply Blog
feeds.description: Woman Owned and Operated by someone who is insanely passionate in many aspects of skating and loves to share her knowledge with her customers! As a competitive inline speed skater, skating mom, and coach I know how important it is to have a reliable product, service, and availability. I strive to provide you with what you need when you need it.

feeds.title: Rollerland Skate Center Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Rollerland Skate Center, home of the best affordable entertainment in Fort Collins! Our family fun center offers something for everyone! From roller skating to an indoor playground and even an exciting laser maze.

feeds.title: Rolla Skate Club Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on rollerskating news, inspiration, tips, and more from Rolla Skate Club is an empowered community of strong skaters.

feeds.title: RollerFitness Ltd Blog
feeds.description: Our RollerFitness blog is full of great content for fitness professionals as well as beginner roller skaters. Check out some of our most recent blog posts on roller skating fitness and learn all the benefits of working out on your roller skates or roller blades using exercises you can do at home. RollerFitness is an online CPD training programme.

feeds.title: Skateland Hickory Blog
feeds.description: At Skateland Hickory, we love seeing kids experience the joy of roller skating. We have proudly watched the cycle as some of the kids that came here when we first got started in the early 1970s are now returning with their children and grandchildren.

feeds.title: Sky-Vue Skateland Blog
feeds.description: We're a family-owned and operated roller skating rink serving third and fourth-generation families in Rocky Mount. Vernon and Pauline Holder built and opened Sky-Vue Skateland to huge crowds and a great fanfare in September 1958. It was their dream project to provide the citizens of Rocky Mount and the surrounding communities with wholesome, family fun.
